reasons.plausibility: Interfacial barriers to dislocation motion are a well-established strengthening and creep-resistance mechanism in multiphase alloys, making this hypothesis scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: Comparative creep tests on refined vs. coarsened interface networks, combined with microstructural examination, provide a direct, feasible method to confirm or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis targets an important practical challenge in high-entropy alloy coatings and outlines a specific pathway to improve creep performance, making it highly relevant and actionable for researchers.
